text:
Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502.

A deploy at 14:02 removed the cache warmup step. Without this step, the cache was empty at startup. The origin servers received all requests directly. The origin servers reached their connection limit and returned HTTP 502.

We reverted the deploy at 14:27. The cache filled again. Error rates returned to normal at 14:31.

No data was lost. Failed requests returned an error and did not change any records.

We will add the cache warmup step to the deploy checks. A deploy that removes this step will fail the checks.
